name: vscode-kaoto
description: Kaoto - The Integration Designer for Apache Camel
author: The Kaoto Team

scripts.build:prod: rimraf dist && yarn run compile && yarn run lint
scripts.build:dev: rimraf dist && yarn run watch && yarn run lint
scripts.build:test:ui: rimraf ./out && tsc --project tsconfig.ui-tests.json --skipLibCheck --sourceMap true && yarn run lint
scripts.build:test:unit: rimraf ./out && tsc --project tsconfig.unit-tests.json --skipLibCheck --sourceMap true && yarn run lint

walkthroughs.title: Kaoto first steps

steps.title: Open Kaoto view
steps.description:
Click the **Kaoto icon** in the Activity Bar to open the Kaoto view.

[Open Kaoto View](command:workbench.view.extension.kaoto-view)

steps.title: Open workspace
steps.description:
Open an existing workspace or create a new one.

[Open Workspace](command:vscode.openFolder)

steps.title: Create a new Camel Route
steps.description:
Click the ``New File...`` button inside Integrations view to create a new Camel Route.

[New Camel Route...](command:kaoto.new.camel.file)

steps.description: Click the ``Pause`` button inside Deployments view to pause the Camel Route.

steps.title: Resume the Camel Route
steps.description: Click the ``Resume`` button inside Deployments view to resume the Camel Route.

steps.title: Terminate the Camel Route
steps.description: Click the ``Terminate`` button inside Deployments view to terminate the Camel Route.

steps.title: Show the Camel Route source code
steps.description: Click the ``Show Source`` button inside Integrations view or click the Source Code icon in the editor title to show the Camel Route source code.

steps.title: Explore extension settings

[Open Kaoto Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22@ext:redhat.vscode-kaoto%22%5D)

kaoto.catalog.url.markdownDescription:
URL to a Kaoto catalog. For instance `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KaotoIO/camel-catalog/refs/heads/main/catalog/index.json `. Documentation to generate your own set of catalog is available [here](https://kaoto.io/docs/designer/04-runtime-selector/).

It requires to reopen the Kaoto editors to be effective.

**Note**: Use the Kaoto editor status bar to select from a custom catalogs.

kaoto.localKameletDirectories.markdownDescription:
List of local directories to be used for Kamelet files. It is used for every run by adding `--local-kamelet-dir` argument into `#kaoto.executor.runArguments#` or `#kaoto.executor.runFolderOrWorkspaceArguments#` settings.

**Note**: The setting can be overridden by the `--local-kamelet-dir` argument set in mentioned run arguments settings.

Supports common variables - `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolderBasename}`, `${cwd}`

redhat.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable usage data and errors to be sent to Red Hat servers. Read our [privacy statement](https://developers.redhat.com/article/tool-data-collection).

kaoto.nodeLabel.markdownDescription:
Node label, which will be used for nodes in the canvas. Can be either `description` or `id`. If `description` is selected, it will be displayed only if it is available, otherwise `id` will be displayed by default.

It requires to reopen the Kaoto editors to be effective.

kaoto.nodeToolbarTrigger.markdownDescription:
Choose when to open the Node toolbar. Can be either `onHover` or `onSelection`. If `onHover` is selected, the toolbar will be automatically open upon hovering a node, otherwise, it will be open when selecting a node.

It requires to reopen the Kaoto editors to be effective.

kaoto.colorTheme.markdownDescription:
Choose the color theme for the UI. `auto` will follow VS Code theme, `light` and `dark` will set that theme regardless of VS Code theme.

It requires to reopen the Kaoto editors to be effective.

kaoto.canvasLayoutDirection.markdownDescription:
Choose the layout direction for the canvas. `SelectInCanvas` will allow to select nodes in the canvas, `Horizontal` and `Vertical` will set the layout direction.

It requires to reopen the Kaoto editors to be effective.

kaoto.views.refresh.interval.markdownDescription: Set default auto-refresh interval in milliseconds for a views (Deployments, Infrastructure). **Default recommended interval is 30s.**

kaoto.integrations.files.regexp.markdownDescription: Regular expression to filter files to be displayed in `Kaoto > Integrations` view.

kaoto.tests.files.regexp.markdownDescription: Regular expression to filter files to be displayed in `Kaoto > Tests` view.

kaoto.openapi.files.regexp.markdownDescription: Regular expression to filter files to be displayed in `Kaoto > OpenAPI` view.

enumDescriptions: Use JBang to execute Camel commands (requires JBang installation)
(experimental) Use Camel Launcher to execute Camel commands
kaoto.executor.type.markdownDescription:
Select the executor type for running Camel integrations.

**JBang**: Traditional approach using JBang CLI (requires JBang installation).

**Camel Launcher**: (experimental) New approach using standalone Camel Launcher (no JBang required, automatically downloaded).

kaoto.executor.runArguments.markdownDescription:
User defined arguments to be applied at every launch. In case of spaces, the values needs to be enclosed with quotes.

**User settings take priority:** If you define arguments like `--management-port`, `--port`, `--console`, `--camel-version`, or `--repos`, your values will override the extension's defaults. Warnings will be shown in the output when conflicts are detected.

**Port resolution:** When you specify `--management-port` or `--port`, the Deployments view will automatically monitor the port you defined instead of the default port. This ensures proper tracking of running integrations.

For possible values see [official docs](https://camel.apache.org/manual/camel-jbang.html#_creating_and_running_camel_routes).

kaoto.executor.runFolderOrWorkspaceArgum.markdownDescription:
User defined arguments to be applied at every launch of a folder or workspace. In case of spaces, the values needs to be enclosed with quotes.

**User settings take priority:** If you define arguments like `--management-port`, `--port`, `--console`, `--camel-version`, or `--repos`, your values will override the extension's defaults. Warnings will be shown in the output when conflicts are detected.

**Port resolution:** When you specify `--management-port` or `--port`, the Deployments view will automatically monitor the port you defined instead of the default port. This ensures proper tracking of running integrations.

For possible values see [official docs](https://camel.apache.org/manual/camel-jbang.html#_creating_and_running_camel_routes).

kaoto.executor.redHatMavenRepository.markdownDescription: Define Red Hat Maven Repository, which is used automatically in case the `#kaoto.camelVersion#` uses Red Hat productized Camel version (e.g. `4.8.0.redhat-00017`).

kaoto.executor.redHatMavenRepository.glo.markdownDescription:
The `#repos` placeholder will be added by default to use also repositories defined in global Camel configuration file.

**Note**: The placeholder is available for versions `3.20.7/3.21` onwards.

kaoto.executor.kubernetesRunArguments.markdownDescription:
User defined arguments to be applied at every deploy (See [Camel Kubernetes plugin](https://camel.apache.org/manual/camel-jbang-kubernetes.html)). In case of spaces, the values needs to be enclosed with quotes.

**User settings take priority:** If you define `--camel-version`, your value will override the extension's default from `#kaoto.camelVersion#`. Warnings will be shown in the output when conflicts are detected.

Beware that `--disable-auto`, which is provided by default, requires Camel 4.11+.

kaoto.executor.infraArguments.markdownDescription: User defined arguments to be applied by default when starting services from `Kaoto > Infrastructure`. (See [Camel Infra Run](https://camel.apache.org/manual/jbang-commands/camel-jbang-infra-run.html))

kaoto.maven.dependenciesUpdate.onSave.markdownDescription: Enable automatic update of Camel dependencies in pom.xml on save.

kaoto.maven.executor.exportProjectArgume.markdownDescription:
User defined arguments to be applied at every export of a Maven project. In case of spaces, the values needs to be enclosed with quotes.

**User settings take priority:** If you define arguments like `--camel-version` or `--repos`, your values will override the extension's defaults. Warnings will be shown in the output when conflicts are detected.

For possible values see [official docs](https://camel.apache.org/manual/camel-jbang.html#_creating_projects).

kaoto.restConfiguration.apicurioRegistry.markdownDescription: URL to the Apicurio Registry. It is used to store and manage REST API specifications. Example: `https://registry.example.com/apis/registry/v3`

kaoto.restConfiguration.customMediaTypes.markdownDescription: These values are available in Rest DSL Consumes/Produces fields. Add media type (e.g. `application/vnd.api+json`).

kaoto.runtimeCatalogName.markdownDescription:
⚠️ **WORKSPACE-ONLY SETTING** - This setting only works in Workspace/Folder settings, not User settings.

Selected runtime catalog name for integration files (e.g., 'Camel Main 4.14.7', 'Camel Quarkus 3.35.0').

**Note**: Use the status bar to select from available catalogs.

kaoto.testingCatalogName.markdownDescription:
⚠️ **WORKSPACE-ONLY SETTING** - This setting only works in Workspace/Folder settings, not User settings.

Selected testing catalog name for test files (e.g., 'Citrus 4.10.1').

**Note**: Use the status bar to select from available catalogs.

kaoto.infrastructure.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the `Infrastructure` view and its related commands. When disabled (default), the view is hidden. Enable this setting to try out Camel Infra service management.
